bundle.shortDescription: Making complex reasoning clear through maps you can check and question.
bundle.longDescription: Ipsissima opens an Argdown map of a text beside the text itself: the argument and its reasons, the order the text tells them in, what it says happens, and the tables of what it compares. Each is a way in to question it: suppose a claim false and see what follows, guess before you look, weigh rival accounts, or study it on your own.

fileAssociations.name: Argdown reconstruction
fileAssociations.description: An Argdown argument reconstruction, optionally carrying its manuscript
